facts.fact: 玉米地中央桩位空无一人，Clay 蹲看血渍，最怕 Vero 已杀 Cave
facts.anchor: I really hope Vero hasn’t done something stupid—like killed Cave

facts.fact: 两小时拉网搜寻落空，Clay 判断 Vero 刻意躲藏
facts.anchor: wherever Vero is, he doesn’t want to be found

facts.fact: Clay 排除投水可能：Vero 高调，现身必成 spectacle
facts.anchor: He has Cave with him, and drowning is not Vero’s style

facts.fact: Kayla 崩溃边缘自陈：Aaron 出狱后一直在看她，她以为岛上安全
facts.anchor: “He told me he has been watching me since he got out of prison. I thought I was safe here, but he still found me.”

facts.fact: Clay 一句点破孤立真相，Kayla 当场落泪
facts.anchor: “You didn’t know if we were coming.”

facts.fact: Brawley 忧虑核心：Vero 发作中记得很多，届时会把正义重新解释为失控
facts.anchor: if Vero knows that, then whatever he is doing feels like justice to him now, but when he comes down

facts.fact: Brawley 预言 Vero 归家后的自我审判：怕自己也会伤害 Kayla
facts.anchor: He will convince himself he did it because he lost control, not because the asshole deserved it

facts.fact: 三人推演：Cave 若按住 Vero 不让他有出口，无目标的 Vero 反而更危险
facts.anchor: Vero with a target gives him direction
